text:
sam_ae: Hey team — EpsilonBank POC next Thurs, 9am-3pm PST. They want a demo of heavy chat load. Can we get an ephemeral pre-warm / headroom reservation on a dedicated pool? thinking ~8 GPUs for 6 hours plus a short burst window.
jamie_se: +1. Need to confirm autoscale policy and whether we can do soft-reserve (non-billing unless used) vs hard commit. Also need API keys and KMS scope for logs.
ryan_infra: We can provision an ephemeral pool and tag it `eps-poc-prewarm`. Two options: soft-headroom (credits escrow) or short-term reservation (billing commit). Which does sales prefer?
sam_ae: Prefers soft-headroom if possible to avoid commit. Sales needs predictable latency guarantees for the demo though. Could we do soft-headroom with guaranteed pre-warm (no cold starts) for the 1-hour ramp before start?
vikram_runtime: We can pre-load KV caches and spin warm workers. For that we need the exact model + max seq length and expected concurrency. Also need the routing tag so requests hit the pool: `route=eps-poc`.
jamie_se: Model will be `redwood-13b-v2-q4` for fidelity. Seq len ~1024, concurrency target 120 qps peak.
ryan_infra: OK. For soft-headroom flow we do: 1) allocate pool with min=8 GPUs and max=16 GPUs, 2) pre-warm tasks to keep min warmed 1h before demo, 3) attach burst credits bucket for short spikes. We'll need a PO number or approval for credit escrow.
sam_ae: I can sign off on escrow up to $2k for the demo. Is that enough?
elaine_csm: For enterprise POCs we usually ask SSO + IP allowlist for API keys. EpsilonBank requires VPC peering for Private; but for this demo they accepted hosted dedicated with IP allowlist. Also pass the security questionnaire item about KMS — we need to restrict key access to the pool service account.
jamie_se: Noted. Can we surface an autoscale policy snippet for ops to apply?
vikram_runtime: here's a minimal policy we can apply:
```
{"min_gpus":8, "max_gpus":16, "scale_up_threshold_qps":100, "cooldown_seconds":120, "burst_credit_bucket":"eps-demo-credits"}
```
Add `prewarm=true` to force warm workers before start.
ryan_infra: That looks good. We also need a graceful drain window of 5m for teardown. For IP allowlist, drop the customer IPs into the pool ACL; send me CIDR list.
sam_ae: CIDRs: 54.12.34.0/24, 3.45.67.128/26 — will send in a follow-up DM (security).
jamie_se: Question on pricing: if we use soft-headroom + burst credits and they exceed escrow, does it auto-fallback to hosted throttling or will it bill the customer?
ryan_infra: For soft-headroom we cap usage to escrow. If the escrow is exhausted we can auto-fallback to hosted-compatible smaller model or throttle. Need your approval on fallback policy now.
sam_ae: Approve auto-fallback to `redwood-7b-v2-q4` with throttling after escrow is used. Please document in the runbook.
vikram_runtime: Will add route-based fallback and model pin in rollout config. Also configuring `prewarm=true` job to run 60m before event.
deploy-bot: pool `eps-poc-prewarm` provisioning scheduled by infra at 2025-11-06T15:00:00Z; will post updates to this thread. :white_check_mark:
jamie_se: Thanks — can ops confirm access for the AE to fetch demo API key (scoped, read-only metrics + route tag)?
ryan_infra: Yes, will create scoped key `eps-demo-read` and add to vault. Sam, you'll get a short-lived key valid for 12h.
elain_csm: I'll attach the KMS control checklist to the security questionnaire that Sam will send.
sam_ae: Great — timeline looks good. One more ask: can we have a small pre-demo smoke test 2h before with a sanitized prompt set? Want to verify latencies under expected traffic.
vikram_runtime: Yep — we'll run the smoke test with synthetic traffic generator and post traces to the console.
jamie_se: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer with approved fallback and escrow details. :thumbsup:
